_comment: Building types for player placement, Phase 4 (SIMULATION_SPEC.md §7.2, roadmap 4.1). Read by autoloads/buildings.gd. footprint_cells is [width, length] in 2m terrain cells before rotation. build_materials + build_labour_hours are placeholder construction costs (the spec only fully specifies the church's seven stages, §9.1, which are a Phase 8 concern) — sized to feel roughly proportionate to footprint and worker_slots, and easy to retune here without touching code. requires_mortar gates a stone building's UNDER_CONSTRUCTION progress on Weather.temperature_c() via tuning construction.frost_gate_temp_c (SIMULATION_SPEC.md §11). storage_capacity + open_air are only meaningful on category 'storage' (§7.2's storage table; open_stockpile is the one that 'spoils in rain', modelled as double spoilage in autoloads/buildings.gd). Which goods a storage building accepts is not repeated here — it is derived from each good's storable_in list in data/goods.json, so there is one place that mapping lives. colour/roof_colour key into data/palette.json, same convention as data/precinct.json, for the greybox renderer. This list covers the Phase 4 exit criteria (a granary, and the timber/stone chain that feeds it); the rest of §7.2's ~30 building types are added as later phases' chains need them — a JSON entry each, zero code changes.
